tools.name: ipv4_subnet_calculate
tools.description: Compute IPv4 CIDR network address, broadcast address, netmask, wildcard mask, usable host range, and private RFC1918 classification.

tools.name: ipv4_representation_convert
tools.description: Convert an IPv4 address (dotted, 32-bit decimal, or 0x hex) into binary octets, hex, decimal integer, IPv6-mapped ::ffff: format, and in-addr.arpa.

tools.name: ipv4_cidr_range_expand
tools.description: Convert an arbitrary start-to-end IPv4 range into exact minimal aggregated CIDR blocks (e.g. 10.0.0.0 - 10.0.0.255 -> 10.0.0.0/24).

tools.name: ipv6_cidr_calculate
tools.description: Expand compressed IPv6 addresses to full 128-bit hextets, classify scope (link-local, ULA, global, multicast), and compute network prefix range.

tools.name: mac_oui_inspect
tools.description: Parse MAC-48 / EUI-48 addresses, identify U/L local vs universal bit and unicast/multicast bit, format notations (colon/dash/Cisco), and compute EUI-64 link-local IPv6.

tools.name: webrtc_sdp_inspect
tools.description: Parse WebRTC Session Description Protocol (SDP) offers/answers for media sections (audio/video/application), codecs (VP8/VP9/AV1/Opus), ICE candidates, and DTLS fingerprint.

tools.name: websocket_frame_decode
tools.description: Decode raw RFC-6455 WebSocket binary frames (FIN bit, opcode, mask flag, 7/16/64-bit payload length, unmasking XOR key, and decoded payload).

tools.name: har_performance_analyze
tools.description: Analyze HTTP Archive (.har) JSON waterfalls for total transfer size, slow endpoints, HTTP 4xx/5xx failures, MIME breakdown, and uncompressed payloads.

tools.name: http_headers_security_audit
tools.description: Audit raw HTTP response headers for HSTS, CSP, X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy, and server fingerprint leakage.

tools.name: cache_control_parse_and_build
tools.description: Parse or build HTTP Cache-Control headers (max-age, s-maxage, stale-while-revalidate, immutable, private, no-store) with CDN vs browser TTL breakdown.

tools.name: robots_txt_evaluate
tools.description: Parse robots.txt groups, Sitemaps, and Disallow/Allow path precedence to test whether a specific User-Agent is allowed to crawl a target URL path.

tools.name: sitemap_xml_validate
tools.description: Validate XML sitemap.xml or sitemapindex structure, count <url>/<loc> entries, detect duplicate URLs, and check invalid URL schemes.

tools.name: rss_atom_feed_validate
tools.description: Validate RSS 2.0 or Atom XML syndication feeds for required channel/feed elements, entry count, pubDate/updated dates, and links.

tools.name: json_ld_schema_validate
tools.description: Extract and validate Schema.org JSON-LD blocks (from raw JSON-LD or HTML <script type="application/ld+json"> tags) for @context and @type completeness.

tools.name: html_accessibility_audit
tools.description: Static-audit HTML for WCAG accessibility defects: missing , , <img> alt text, form <label> associations, empty buttons/links, and heading skips.

tools.name: subtitle_convert_srt_vtt
tools.description: Convert SubRip (.srt) to WebVTT (.vtt), plain transcript (.txt), or reverse VTT -> SRT with exact millisecond timestamp preservation.

tools.name: subtitle_time_shift_and_fix
tools.description: Shift all SRT/VTT subtitle timestamps forward/backward by exact milliseconds and detect overlapping cues.

tools.name: media_container_inspect
tools.description: Inspect MP4/ISO-BMFF box atoms (ftyp, moov, mdat, trak), WebM/MKV EBML headers, WAV RIFF chunks, or MP3 ID3/frame headers.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "net-web-media" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: robots_txt_evaluate, sitemap_xml_validate · Private data: ipv4_subnet_calculate, cache_control_parse_and_build · Public sink: ipv4_subnet_calculate, subtitle_time_shift_and_fix · Destructive: ipv4_representation_convert, mac_oui_inspect.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: robots_txt_evaluate, sitemap_xml_validate · Private data: ipv4_subnet_calculate, cache_control_parse_and_build · Public sink: ipv4_subnet_calculate, subtitle_time_shift_and_fix · Destructive: ipv4_representation_convert, mac_oui_inspect

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
